headline: Physicists Trapped a Particle of Antimatter And Kept It Caged For Months
body_markdown:
Annihilation free, baby! ScienceAlert stories are written, fact-checked, and edited by humans, never generated by AI. (ScienceAlert)

**Nature** adds: Nature, Published online: 21 October 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03342-2 Physicists trap and cool down positron for months to measure its ‘magnetic moment’ with extraordinary precision.

**Scientific American** adds: For the first time, scientists can make quantum measurements on a positron particle

This digest was assembled automatically from reporting by Scientific American, ScienceAlert and Nature. Follow the source links below for the full coverage.
